tips.summon: Welcome! Drag a troop from your hand onto your back row (the bottom row, next to your Stronghold) to summon it. You have 1 crystal, enough for a cost-1 troop.
tips.move: Nice! Now march it forward: next turn, press Done to reach the Action phase, then drag your troop to an empty space. Each troop either moves OR attacks.
tips.capture: Walk next to a glowing crystal site in the middle. Have more troops around it than the enemy to take it, and watch it change to your color!
tips.spend: Crystals are your money. Summon another troop or upgrade one by tapping it in the Deploy phase to spend them.
tips.fight: Time to fight! In the Action phase drag a troop onto the enemy troop. Melee hits are simultaneous: both strike. Damage heals at the start of your next turn.
tips.spell: Cast a spell! Drag Fireball from your hand onto an enemy (spells cost crystals of any color).
tips.commander: Finally, move next to the enemy Stronghold and attack the Commander. Each hit removes health equal to the attacker's Attack. Make them retreat!
